_comment: Bands, weights and caps for the fun metrics. This file is the iteration surface - tune here, not in code. See docs/FUN_METRICS.md for what each number means.
_fingerprint_layers_note: Layers whose method alternatives count as a different *idea*. Adding 'actions' splits classes by dispatcher path (e.g. which of the three applyTagNotPresent routes was taken); that is finer than most authors mean by 'a way to solve it', so it is off by default.
_fingerprint_max_depth_note: A strategy is a choice made near the top of a plan. Method alternatives deeper than this are implementation detail, not a different idea. Depth 0 is the goal, 1 is the strategy it picks.
_actor_position_note: Which operator argument names the actor, by convention. A level overrides per operator with funActor(opName, index) and excludes bookkeeping operators with funNoop(opName).

f2_distinctness._severe_distance_factor_note: A closest pair below min_pairwise_distance_min * this factor is a FAIL unless ablation proves the classes independent.

f4_choice._feasibility_edges_note: At or above saturated_at almost any pick wins (FAIL); at or below unsatisfiable_below no pick wins (FAIL).

f5_discovery._red_herring_note: No minimum: unused scenery is a tool the author may use, not something the scorecard rewards.
